Branch: feat/entitlement-v31 (lineage: novaflow -> feat/entitlement-v31)
Commit: d06787e3c02ba02e8be8dd74f4077a5e7036ecfc
Package: dsh-douyin-comments 0.9.22

This snapshot merges the former dsh-comment-viewer into the collector plugin and
adds the NovaFlow subscription gate: an activation code binds one NovaFlow
account, up to two devices, with material issued at runtime through the local
relay.
The upstream repository carries no license file. It is bundled into NovaFlow
with the project owner's arrangement with the author for NovaFlow integration.
Do not redistribute this snapshot separately without the author's permission.
